findings.summary: VIEW_PATH_MAP erroneously mapped /activity and /automation to overview and omitted /help, causing 404s and broken navigation.
Mobile drawer hamburger toggle button was omitted from topbar header, making drawer navigation unreachable on <1024px viewports.
PrivacyPolicyModal lacked Escape key listener and backdrop dismissal on optional views, creating a keyboard focus trap.

findings.category: Authorization and IDOR (cross-account reads/writes, admin surfaces)
findings.summary: POST /api/auth/2fa/send-challenge returned raw unmasked phone numbers and differential responses, exposing PII and enabling user enumeration.
Broken JWT integer sub claim verification, revocation bypass, and flawed admin resolution in require_admin_user.
AuthModal locked email 2FA to 6 digits and inert resend button; SessionExpiryModal omitted 2FA handling, permanently locking out expired 2FA sessions.
GDPR erasure bypassed public_id child tables (AdminMessage/Notice) and orphaned dump files, attachments, and exports on disk.

findings.category: Input handling, injection and file upload edges
findings.summary: CSV formula injection (CWE-1236) and naive quote concatenation in flashcards and assignment history exports.
Unpinned scrapling dependency in sidecar and vulnerable multipart / unconstrained bounds in server dependencies.

findings.category: Input handling, injection and file upload edges
findings.summary: DELETE /api/dump/{id} deleted database row without unlinking on-disk user assignment files.
httpx timeout mismatch (30s client vs 50s long-poll) and sequential bot polling loop causing multi-minute bot latency starvation.

findings.category: Database correctness, migrations and query cost
findings.summary: Missing composite indexes on high-frequency filters (user_id + created_at/entry_date) and silent migration error swallowing in init_db.

findings.category: Frontend performance (bundle, race conditions, render loops)
findings.summary: Dual focus/visibilitychange event flood triggering duplicate simultaneous fetches, out-of-order race conditions, and unmounted state updates.

findings.category: Browser extension parity with the web app
findings.summary: Missing asyncio import in routes_extension caused runtime NameError crashes on extension version checks and downloads.

findings.category: Infrastructure and operational safety (systemd, backups, health checks)
findings.summary: helpotron-backup.service missing data directory in ReadWritePaths preventing SQLite WAL backups; backup_db.sh failed on URI query params.
Invalid tool response retry loops failed to increment steps, burning unbounded tokens for up to 1hr; unmetered sessions and unbounded message history.

findings.category: Infrastructure and operational safety (systemd, backups, health checks)
findings.summary: Stale Nginx Content-Security-Policy omitted Cloudflare Turnstile origins, breaking user authentication behind reverse proxy.
